items.title: Crimean Bridge rail traffic suspended after reported Ukrainian attack
items.summary: Crimean leader Sergey Aksyonov said Ukrainian forces attacked the Crimean Bridge for a third time this week, prompting authorities to suspend rail traffic while assessing damage. The extent of damage and the duration of the suspension were not specified.

items.title: Pentagon official reportedly leaves meeting before Ukrainian defence briefing
items.summary: The Telegraph reportedly said US Under Secretary of Defense Elbridge Colby left a meeting with European allies before Ukrainian Defence Minister Khmara could deliver a classified battlefield briefing. The account says Colby had criticized Ukrainian strikes deep inside Russian territory.

items.title: Finnish ICEYE unveils higher-resolution Gen5 radar satellite platform
items.summary: ICEYE's new Gen5 synthetic-aperture radar platform reportedly offers imagery resolution as fine as 11 centimetres and improved imaging capacity, including in darkness and cloud cover. A Russian military analysis says ICEYE imagery is already used to support Ukrainian reconnaissance and strike assessments, making the upgrade relevant to battlefield intelligence.
